title: 第二十三章 国师踏云飞天暴君泣血坠马第二十四章 水生让钟
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: “国师以为，朕便没有什么手段不成？”
那一百多修炼偷天魔功的二流高手，便是皇帝的依仗！
国师府四周，更是有着大量的黑甲骑士，手持铁弓，只等皇帝一声令下。
国师哈哈大笑，“肉眼凡胎，岂可识得仙人变化？”
道完，国师一甩拂尘，脚下生云，凌空飞走。
血梅会和浩然会一众高手，站在屋顶上，呆呆地看着眼前这一幕，只见得国师越飞越高，根本不是人力能够触碰到的高度。
九千岁李忠自宫墙上飞出，凌空虚踏数十步，却是只能止步百丈高，骤然落下。
还有一个白发老魔，手中一柄金刀斩出一刀，金雷般的刀光飞了百丈，斩在国师身上。
然而国师身上只是金光一闪，便消弭于无形。
李忠俯身在崇明帝面前跪下，“陛下，老奴无能！”
满城铁甲，一百修炼偷天魔功的高手，两位宗师，血梅会浩然会十多位一流高手。
此刻竟然是只能眼睁睁看着国师飞走，却没有任何办法！
李水生怔怔看着眼前这一幕，无奈摇头。
“修仙者与凡人，根本不可同日而语。”
“只是一个简单的飞行术法，我等便没有任何办法。”
“直接飞是吧，脸都不要了！”
他摸了摸下巴，其实国师走了也好，真的与国师大战一场，李水生心里也没底。
国师不过一个人而已，固然身上大包小包，又能带走多少东西？
而国师一走，如今局面，加上李水生三位宗师在场。
李忠要护卫皇帝，无暇他顾。
石老魔被镇压了三十多年，实力又还能剩下几成？
如今京师，我实力最强！
剩下的宝物，全是我的！
崇明帝站在马车上，眼神恍惚。
“你如何敢骗朕？”
“你如何敢骗朕！”
七十二岁的崇明帝，咳出一口血来。
这一口，似乎是将三十年的心血都吐了出来。
崇明帝站立不稳，从马车上摔落。
血泊中，崇明帝伸手，抓向天空，似乎是想要将国师从天上抓下。
他的话没有说完，头一歪倒在地上。
周围顿时大乱，李忠飞速向前，“保护陛下！”
“救驾！”
“救驾！”
对面的浩然会，双目直欲喷火。
content_en:
"The Imperial Master thinks that I don't have any means to do it?"
Those more than a hundred second-rate masters who practice the Heaven-stealing Demonic Art are the emperor's support!
Around the Imperial Preceptor's Mansion, there were a large number of black-armored knights holding iron bows, just waiting for the emperor's order.
The Imperial Master laughed loudly, "How can the human eye with the naked eye recognize the transformation of an immortal?"
After finishing his speech, the Imperial Master flicked his fly whisk, clouds formed under his feet, and he flew away in the sky.
A group of experts from the Blood Plum Club and the Haoran Club stood on the roof and stared blankly at the scene in front of them. They saw the Imperial Master flying higher and higher, which was not at a height that human beings could reach.
Nine-thousand-year-old Li Zhong flew out from the palace wall and took dozens of steps in the air, but he could only stop a hundred feet high and suddenly fell.
There was also a white-haired old demon who slashed out with a golden sword in his hand. The golden thunder-like sword light flew a hundred feet and struck the Imperial Master.
However, there was only a flash of golden light on the Imperial Master's body, and it disappeared without a trace.
Li Zhong leaned over and knelt down in front of Emperor Chongming, "Your Majesty, this old slave is incompetent!"
The city is covered with iron armor, one hundred masters practicing the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Art, two grand masters, and the Blood Plum Club has more than a dozen first-rate masters.
At this moment, all I could do was watch the Imperial Master fly away, but there was nothing I could do!
Li Shuisheng stared at the scene in front of him and shook his head helplessly.
"There is no difference between immortal cultivators and ordinary people."
"It's just a simple flying spell, there's nothing we can do about it."
"Fly right away, you don't even have to face shame!"
He touched his chin. In fact, even if the Imperial Master left, Li Shuisheng would not be sure if he really had a battle with the Imperial Master.
The Imperial Master is just one person. Although he has a lot of bags on his body, how much can he take with him?
As soon as the national master left, the situation now changed with the presence of three grand masters, Li Shuisheng.
Li Zhong wanted to protect the emperor and had no time for him.
The Stone Old Demon has been suppressed for more than thirty years, how much strength does he still have left?
Now in the capital, I am the strongest!
The remaining treasures are all mine!
Emperor Chongming stood on the carriage with his eyes in a trance.
"How dare you lie to me?"
"How dare you lie to me!"
"No!"
"Poof!"
The seventy-two-year-old Emperor Chongming coughed up a mouthful of blood.
This mouthful seemed to spit out thirty years of hard work.
Emperor Chongming could not stand firmly and fell from the carriage.
In a pool of blood, Emperor Chongming reached out and grabbed the sky, as if he wanted to grab the imperial master from the sky.
"I..."
"I..."
"Longevity...."
"It's actually...a big dream..."
"A...game..."
Before he could finish his words, his head fell to the ground.
There was chaos all around, and Li Zhong quickly moved forward, "Protect Your Majesty!"
"Help!"
"Help!"
Across from him, Haoran Hui's eyes were about to spit fire.
title_en: Chapter 23: The national master rides on the clouds and flies into the sky, and the tyrant falls from his horse in tears. Chapter 24: Shuisheng Rangzhong
